notices.title: Sleeping Giant Picnic Site: check seasonal boat access
notices.text: USFS lists services closed but permits walk-in picnicking. Confirm usable boat access and parking with the ranger district before a shuttle. The site is day use only; the nearby ski-area approach is a separate location.
notices.sourceName: Shoshone National Forest — Sleeping Giant Picnic Site

sections.routeReview: Dotted course withheld: cloud-free imagery shows parts of the older source line crossing wooded former channels around Eagle Creek. Access areas can be shown independently; a newer river trace is needed.

putInAccess.sourceName: Wyoming Game and Fish river access inventory; Shoshone National Forest facility guidance
putInAccess.note: WGFD explicitly lists this site as a launch. The current USFS page independently locates the picnic facility; USGS NAIP imagery places the WGFD point beside its riverside loop. Approximate access area, not a surveyed launch or bank-side instruction. USFS lists services closed and allows walk-in picnicking; that does not establish vehicle or boat access while the gate is closed. Day use only; no overnight use.
putInAccess.directions: Use the signed Sleeping Giant Picnic Site on the south side of US 14/16/20, about 48 miles west of Cody. This is the picnic site, not the separate ski-area bridge. Check the gate and boat-carry access before arranging a shuttle; no shoreline connector is mapped.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Wyoming Game and Fish river access inventory; Shoshone National Forest facility guidance
takeOutAccess.note: WGFD lists launch and egress. USFS documents this campground beside the Shoshone; cloud-free USGS NAIP imagery confirms that the WGFD river point and the USFS center about 400 metres upstream refer to different parts of the same campground. Keep the agency river-access area point, rather than moving it to the campground center. The current USFS page says closed for the 2026 season and warns that the footbridge is unsafe after flooding. This map identifies the facility for planning, not current opening or a safe carry.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the signed Eagle Creek Campground entrance off US 14/16/20, about 45 miles west of Cody. The marker shows the WGFD-listed riverside access vicinity beside the downstream campground loop, not the USFS campground-center point or an exact ramp. Confirm seasonal access before setting a shuttle; do not use the closed footbridge.
